assessment: This paper takes an evolutionary approach to investigate the mechanisms by which CD4 regulates T-cell receptor activation and downstream functional responses. The authors identify conserved and coevolving motifs in the extracellular, transmembrane, and intracellular domains of CD4 that appear to regulate multiple aspects of its function. These findings suggest a recalibration of the perception of CD4 as simply an accessory to the central complex of T-cell receptors and CD3 in pMHC-specific T-cell responses.
